controlledPreview.boundary: Instrumented renderer DOM/CSS layout only. Real production renderToolDetailsSurrenderBody calls liveToolContext/standardToolProperties/appendHudGroups using explicit read-only mock goods/menu/native data and mock ready/current original-library identity. Two surrounding tool-list buttons are explicit layout stubs, not production list binding. Build-only IIFE exports do not replace production renderers. Entry city-menu and mobile header/stage markup, inline styles, production CSS/font and equipment SVG implementation are pinned. No mobile host lifecycle, event binding, polling, bridge, engine, LIB, WASM, native actions or real storage read/write run. Three desktop/simulated-mobile viewports do not grant real gameplay, natural menu flow, physical-device or full-HD acceptance.
controlledPreview.processBoundary: Only one new owned Chrome persistent profile and private ephemeral allowlist HTTP. All owned pages/context/server closed; no existing browser/game/CDP/8080/process inventory accessed.

visualReview.reviewedScope: All three sizes standard-255 top/bottom (6), PC custom/no-SVG (2), PC same-DTO eligibility-on/off (2). Remaining screenshots retained as unreviewed raw captures; their DOM evidence was checked.
visualReview.notes: Representative screenshots show readable 0/255 original values, matching six standard property decorations, five decorations in complete/range-absent eligibility-on and none after eligibility-off, plain text for custom/no-SVG, no clipped icon/label horizontal content or document overflow. Mobile tool pane scroll and sticky property controls retain the external Return footer within view. Top/bottom deliberately show different vertical slices; no claim that all rows fit simultaneously.

controlledPreview.scopeLimit: One browser launch; three pages and 33 same-page controlled states; 39 raw screenshots retained and exactly 10 representative images visually inspected. Actual production tool renderer and appendHudGroups use authenticated mock DTO/identity fixtures. The two list buttons are explicit surrounding layout stubs. No production bridge, mobile lifecycle, actual game, LIB/WASM, native action, real storage, real device or full-HD acceptance. No additional default Node tests.

rootVisualReview.notes: Root independently viewed all 10 selected original screenshots. Standard six icons, 0/255 text, plain-text fallback and same captured DTO eligibility-on/off are readable. Mobile top/bottom are different scroll slices; rows may be brought above sticky controls by scrolling, rather than fitting all at once. Return footer remains visible. The other 29 raw screenshots were not independently visually reviewed by Root.
